_comment: Last offline option-premium validation run. Produced by SignalsBrain: python -m brain.validation.runner --symbols BANKNIFTY NIFTY FINNIFTY MIDCPNIFTY --days 30 --trials 12. Read by god-dashboard.html. Regenerate after any engine change; a stale file is worse than none, so the dashboard shows its age.

pooled.verdict: NOT DISTINGUISHABLE FROM LUCK — deflated Sharpe 0.55 (want > 0.95). Positive expectancy but well within noise on only 40 trades.

bySymbol.note: LOSES money on options despite a 51.4% spot hit rate — theta

limitations: All trades priced against one expiry, so signals older than that contract's life understate theta. Results are an OPTIMISTIC bound, not a neutral estimate.
Some signals could not be priced at all (FINNIFTY 25, MIDCPNIFTY 47 skipped) which shrinks the sample further.
40 trades cannot separate skill from luck. Do not size up on this.
Option-chain volume has no history, so it is measured as a liquidity gate only and is not scored into direction.
